provenance: Validation W1 (analysis/out_review/W1_FINAL_REPORT_2026-11-12.md), post hoc analysis of W1.1 on papers left out of the atlas fit: s* is the smallest factor of a band's half-widths, each side its own, around the predicted median in log scale, that brings the per-paper mean coverage to the band's level (one paper, one vote). end80: the 80% band of the day the median control reaches the endpoint (Plan's 'in 8 of 10 studies'), in log days, the variant started as Plan starts a study (each experiment's median first volume and the line's start spread). volume90: the 90% band of one animal's volume as Plan draws it (latent, started from the plan's randomization), scored against the animals' measurements, so the factor carries the measurement noise the band leaves out: the band is where about 9 in 10 measurements are expected. Intervals: MC38 1.08-1.44, CT26 1.06-1.39, B16F10 1.10-1.44. Lines not validated have no entry and keep the engine's bands.
